THE PROJECT

A complex ecosystem.
A clear narrative.

Conceived and structured a documentary series showing how dairy farming connects with milk collection and chilling operations. The story combines farmer experiences with operational processes, quality checks and pricing transparency.

The series brings together institutional support, producer livelihoods and frontline operations to explain the ecosystem through accessible documentary storytelling.

Project leadership

Led project planning, budgeting and scripting, shaping the series structure and coordinating production. This role represents project and communication leadership; it does not claim sole filming or editing authorship.

TAKEAWAYS

Making the system
understandable.

Communication value

The series visualizes relationships between farmers, support services, collection operations and quality standards. It highlights the role of process transparency and farmer welfare in the brand’s story.

Learning

A chapter-based documentary approach lets different audiences explore the same ecosystem through a human story or an operational topic, while maintaining a coherent overall narrative.

Project scope and contribution are based on the campaign lead’s supplied report. No reach, engagement uplift, welfare improvement or market-leadership metric is claimed.

This documentary is presented separately from Jotne Thasha Valobasha. The supplied playlist is publicly titled “Aarong Dairy Documentry 2019”. Episode descriptions summarize the supplied report; creative ownership remains with the respective owners.
